import json, subprocess, sys, time
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
def t(payload, tag):
    t0=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    t1=time.time()
    outs=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x]
    kinds=[o.get('error') or ('states=%d' % len(o['dfa']['accept'])) for o in outs]
    print('%-28s in=%.2fMB rc=%d wall=%.2fs out=%.2fMB %s' %
          (tag, len(payload)/1e6, p.returncode, t1-t0, len(p.stdout)/1e6, kinds[:8]))

# 8 lines of ~1 MiB each: max-size queries
toks=['a','b','c']
qs=[['a']*4096 for _ in range(4)]
req={'services':toks,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'contains','path':['a','b','c']}}],'queries':qs}
one=json.dumps(req).encode()
print('one max-query line bytes', len(one))
t(one*8+b'\n'*7, '8x max queries')

# 8 lines of ~1 MiB of junk (invalid JSON, forces full decode+scan)
junk=b'{"services":["' + b'a'*1000000 + b'"'
t(junk+b'\n'+ (b'x'*1000000+b'\n')*7, 'junk 1MB lines')

# deep nesting at the wire limit (depth 64)
e={'op':'true'}
for _ in range(30):
    e={'op':'not','arg':e}
req2={'services':['a'],'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':e}],'queries':[[],['a']]}
t(json.dumps(req2).encode()*8+b'\n'*7, 'depth-60 nesting x8')

# 32 rules x wide boolean trees near the 256 node cap
atoms=[{'op':'contains','path':['a','b']},{'op':'endswith','path':['b','c']},
       {'op':'startswith','path':['c']},{'op':'match','path':['a','b','c']},
       {'op':'contains','path':['c','c']},{'op':'endswith','path':['a']},
       {'op':'contains','path':['b']},{'op':'match','path':['b','b']},
       {'op':'endswith','path':['a','b','c']},{'op':'startswith','path':['a']}]
rules=[]
for i in range(32):
    rules.append({'action':'allow' if i%3 else 'drop',
                  'when':{'op':'or','args':[atoms[(i+j)%10] for j in range(7)]}})
req3={'services':toks,'rules':rules,'queries':[['a','b','c'],['c','b','a'],[]]}
t(json.dumps(req3).encode()*8+b'\n'*7, '32 rules x10 atoms x8')

# 24 services, long tokens, 10 atoms, 256 queries
svcs=['s%02d_'%i + 'x'*60 for i in range(24)]
at=[{'op':op,'path':[svcs[(i*3+j)%24] for _ in range(3)]} for i,op in enumerate(
    ['contains','endswith','startswith','match','contains','endswith','startswith','match','contains','endswith'])]
req4={'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':at}}],
      'queries':[[svcs[j%24] for j in range(60)] for _ in range(256)]}
t(json.dumps(req4).encode()*8+b'\n'*7, '24 svc x 10 atoms x8')
